Subject: Follow-up: two recommended levers + resources (Quantica benchmark demo)

Hi Samir / Lina —

Thanks again for the chat earlier. Short recap and the two concrete levers we discussed:

1) Batching policy changes
- Move from per-request handling to a size-aware continuous batching window at 8–12ms; we expect ~18–22% token-cost reduction for your median sequence length without raising 95p latency beyond your current SLO.

2) Int8 quantization (fast profile)
- For your retrieval prompts we measured ~0.5–1.3% MRR delta in internal evals; generation prompts saw 1–3% BLEU-style delta depending on prompt complexity. We recommended A/B on a small sample before full rollout.

Attachments: redwood-demo-agenda.docx (agenda), quantica_benchmark_summary.pdf (benchmark)

Next steps:
- Marcus will follow up on architecture notes and an example rollout plan (internal doc + timeline).
- I’ll add the HubSpot record link and HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/1234567/contact/987654321
- Aditya will keep in touch for scheduling a technical onboarding session if you decide to move forward.

If you want the recording, let me know and we’ll share it.

Best,
Evelyn Hart
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
